agri_consultations.expertResponse: Hello Chimwemwe. For Fall Armyworm at vegetative stage: 1) Apply Chlorantraniliprole (Belt) or Emamectin benzoate directly into the whorl in the late afternoon. 2) For Grade A grading: Sun dry grain thoroughly on clean tarpaulins until moisture reaches 12.5-13.0%. Perform the bottle-salt test if you lack a moisture meter. Winnow thoroughly to remove broken kernels and chaff.
agri_consultations.question: How do I identify and manage Fall Armyworm in early vegetative maize, and how does moisture level affect Grade A classification at ADMARC depots?
agri_consultations.aiInitialSummary: Visual analysis suggests early whorl feeding symptoms characteristic of Spodoptera frugiperda (Fall Armyworm). Grade A maize requires moisture content below 13.0% with maximum 2% foreign matter and zero live weevils.
agri_consultations.expertTitle: Senior Agronomist, Chitedze Agricultural Research Station

agri_consultations.aiInitialSummary: Aflatoxin is caused by Aspergillus flavus mold thriving in damp, soil-contacted pods. Mandatory prevention requires lifting at correct physiological maturity (dark markings inside pods) and drying with pods facing upward off bare ground.
